title: Appeal 18960: omitting elevator hoistway smoke vents for a four-storey building (OSSC 3004.1, 2015 IBC basis)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record
code_edition: OSSC 3004.1 (OSSC edition not stated in the item); 2015 IBC cited as basis for the omission

facts.text: Appeal item: OSSC 3004.1 requires vents for hoistways 25 feet or more in height; the proposal eliminates the vents consistent with the 2015 IBC.

Reason given: the 2015 IBC removed the hoistway ventilation section, and an ICC CTC Elevator Lobby Study Group report (cited as page 33 of an attached document) raises stack-effect smoke-movement concerns.
Decision: omission of elevator hoistway venting per 2015 IBC is granted as proposed.
